title: 14 December 1963: Live: Music Hall, Shrewsbury
content:
The Music Hall, a venue in Shrewsbury, Shropshire, saw concerts by many major acts in its time. The events were promoted by Lewis Buckley.

The Beatles performed at the Music Hall on one subsequent occasion, 26 April 1963.

Page last updated: 25 January 2024

  • 2011: Paul McCartney live: Olimpiyskiy Arena, Moscow
  • 2009: Sir Paul McCartney appears on the X Factor
  • 2009: UK album release: Good Evening New York City by Paul McCartney
  • 1999: Paul McCartney live: Cavern Club, Liverpool
  • 1991: George Harrison live: Tokyo Dome, Tokyo
  • 1989: Paul McCartney live: Madison Square Garden, New York City
  • 1980: Recording: Stop And Take The Time To Smell The Roses by Ringo Starr
  • 1979: Wings live: City Hall, Newcastle upon Tyne
  • 1977: Tape copying: London Town by Wings
  • 1975: Paul McCartney calls Mal Evans
  • 1973: Recording: Since My Baby Left Me by John Lennon
  • 1971: John Lennon and Yoko Ono attend farewell luncheon for U Thant
  • 1970: Filming: Fly by John Lennon and Yoko Ono
  • 1969: Television: With A Little Help From My Friends
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Wimbledon Palais, London
